prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small overlay sprite source sheet for a colorful isometric pixel jungle. A clean 2 columns by 2 rows sheet on true transparent background, each sprite isolated within its equal square cell with generous empty gutters. Top left: small clump of pink and golden tropical wildflowers with three stems and green leaves. Top right: small lush fern bush with a few turquoise green leaves and tiny red berries. Bottom left: one orange and turquoise butterfly viewed from above with wings fully open, body vertical. Bottom right: a single light green falling leaf with a short brown twig. Charming crisp pixel-art shapes, warm gentle highlights, rich colors, no ground disks, no shadows, no text, no labels, no borders. Plants viewed in 2:1 isometric perspective, roots at bottom center. Structural source forms only; animation will be applied to the registered pixels.

Remove all colored glow, haze and shadow surrounding the four sprites. Keep precisely the flowers, fern bush, butterfly and leaf artwork and the same 2 by 2 cell layout and pixel detail. Everything outside the actual hard-edged sprite silhouettes must be fully transparent; no floating background pixels. Transparent game sprite sheet.
bake: scripts/art/landscape-accents.ts: 2x2 reviewed cells, opaque alpha fringe threshold, nearest-neighbor, shared atlas.
